channel.title: SecurityWizardry Vulnerability Radar (RMFconsultoria)
channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-116320 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in PostgreSQL plperl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via dropping the final reference to a Perl array or hash while PostgreSQL is converting that object. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116321 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Improper null termination in PostgreSQL array element assignment allows a database user to disclose server memory, via changing the final byte of a fixed-length name value to a nonzero byte and passing it to code that treats the value as a C string. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116322 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | Improper locking in PostgreSQL startup processing allows an unauthenticated network client to trigger a server restart, via arranging for authentication_timeout to arrive while it holds a spinlock during cancel handling. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116323 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in PostgreSQL pltcl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a domain CHECK that re-enters the Tcl interpreter and frees or changes a string still used by the outer result conversion. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116325 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.0 | SQL injection in PostgreSQL reindexdb allows an object creator to execute arbitrary SQL as the database user running reindexdb, via a crafted index name embedded in the parallel catalog query for --jobs with --index. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116326 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Uncaught exceptions in PostgreSQL plperl allow an object creator to cause use of a stale sigjmp_buf, via a tied Perl object, or a Perl object whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error. We have not ruled out arbitrary code execution on some platform. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116327 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Exposure of sensitive information in PostgreSQL security_barrier processing allows a database user to infer values hidden by a security_barrier view, via applying a leaky function to a CASE test value or internal parameter that indirectly represents a protected column. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116328 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL generation memory contexts allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via freeing an allocation larger than 1 GB and causing its block to be reused for smaller chunks whose back-pointer offset cannot represent that position. Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116329 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL statistics import allows a table maintainer to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via nested SET DATA TYPE during conversion of values to import. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116330 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Untrusted data inclusion in PostgreSQL pg_dump tar-format restore.sql allows a compromised origin server to execute arbitrary code as the client operating system account running psql, via the predictable restriction key in restore.sql. This is a gap in the fix for CVE-2025-8714. restore.sql is undocumented. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116331 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL min/max aggregate optimization allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a user-defined aggregate whose SORTOP option causes the planner to treat the aggregate's input and result as the same type when they differ. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116332 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in PostgreSQL portal setup allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via running user-defined code during planning or executor startup that closes the portal currently being prepared. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116333 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL parallel B-tree scans allows an object creator to read attacker-chosen server-memory addresses, via a function incorrectly marked PARALLEL SAFE or STABLE to make participating workers build different scan-key arrays. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116335 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL operator commutator and negator links allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via linking operators having different result types or creating inconsistent reciprocal links. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-116336 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Operation on a dropped index in PostgreSQL REINDEX CONCURRENTLY allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via an index expression that issues DROP INDEX. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120139 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL in-memory tuple-size calculations allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via oversized tuple data. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120141 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL materialized set-returning functions allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via returning rows having different dynamic RECORD return types. json_populate_recordset() is one affected function. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120142 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL anonymous RECORD types allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via row types having dropped attributes in the same positions but with different widths or alignments. Within major versions 17-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 and 17.12 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 17 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120143 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in PostgreSQL trigger functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a cursor over a transition table. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120144 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion from incomplete PostgreSQL type-cache invalidation allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a composite type change while its cache entry is being populated. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120145 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Missing authorization in PostgreSQL logical replication allows a compromised publisher to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the superuser-owned subscription, via naming a system catalog as a replication target. Only subscriptions owned by a superuser are vulnerable. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120146 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Missing authorization in PostgreSQL REASSIGN OWNED allows a role granted INHERIT but not SET to transfer objects to the granted role. It also allows reassignment of database ownership without the CREATEDB privilege. The equivalent ALTER ... OWNER commands block this. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120147 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in the PostgreSQL dblink extension allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via type conversion code that re-enters dblink and closes a connection whose results an outer dblink call is reading. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120148 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL extended statistics allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a statistics expression of an anonymous RECORD type whose backend-local type identifier denotes a different row type in another session. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120149 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL foreign batch inserts allows a foreign server to execute arbitrary code, via reporting that it inserted more rows than the server supplied. postgres_fdw can legitimately encounter this when a rule on the remote table expands an INSERT into additional rows. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120150 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Use after free in PostgreSQL expanded-record domain checks allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via repeated checks of a domain over a composite type that cause reuse of a dangling memory-context pointer. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120151 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL plpgsql record-field assignment allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a reentrant domain CHECK that changes a RECORD variable's row type while a value is being cast. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120152 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Use after free in PostgreSQL pg_show_all_settings() allows a database user to retrieve memory contents, via loading a module while the function is scanning custom-variable placeholders that the module replaces and frees. Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120153 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | SQL injection in PostgreSQL extension-script substitutions allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via a schema or owner name containing newlines or other special substrings. This is similar to CVE-2023-39417, but it requires a non-bundled extension with a vulnerable script pattern. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-120154 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.3 | Improper protection in PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT allows an attacker having INSERT, UPDATE, and applicable SELECT privileges on the table to read every row despite row security policies, via iterated INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. Unlike CVE-2026-16237, this does not facilitate improper writes. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-123790 - NVD - CVSS: não informado
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS: não informado | ComfyUI-Easy-Use version 1.3.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the `save_preview()` handler for POST `/easyuse/save/{name}`. The handler checks the source directory before appending a user-supplied filename and allows the request to select the `custom_nodes` directory as a copy destination. An unauthenticated attacker who can reach the ComfyUI server can overwrite an installed custom node’s Python entry point with an uploaded file. When ComfyUI restarts and loads the modified node, the attacker’s code runs with the privileges of the ComfyUI process.

item.title: CVE-2026-126996 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1 | A vulnerability was determined in SakanaAI text-to-LoRA 0.0.1. Affected by this issue is the function get_tokenizer of the file src/hyper_llm_modulator/utils/model_loading.py of the component Checkpoint Loading. Executing a manipulation of the argument base_model_name_or_path can lead to path traversal. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

item.title: CVE-2026-126997 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5

This affects the function RestTemplate.exchange of the file org/jeecg/modules/airag/flow/c/a.class of the component flow-run Endpoint. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. item.title: CVE-2026-126998 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A security flaw has been discovered in JeecgBoot up to 3.9.5. This vulnerability affects the function OpenApiController.call of the file /openapi/call of the component Authentication Filter. The manipulation results in server-side request forgery. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-14661 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | External control of file name in PostgreSQL dblink and CREATE/ALTER SUBSCRIPTION allows a user to achieve persistent denial of service, via appending invalid data to a chosen file. Specifically, the "sslkeylogfile" connection parameter appends data, in NSS keylog format, to a file of the user's choosing. This "sslkeylogfile" mechanism cannot add arbitrary bytes. Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected. Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are also affected if libpq version 18 or later is installed and in use by the server.

item.title: CVE-2026-16237 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.4 | Improper protection in PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT on auto-updatable views allows an attacker having INSERT and UPDATE privileges on the view to read and modify every row in the view's base table, via iterated INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE. This bypasses the view's WHERE condition, whether or not the view is a security_barrier view. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-16240 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.7 | Use of externally-controlled format string in PostgreSQL pg_basebackup allows an attacker having already compromised a server to achieve disclosure from pg_basebackup memory, via backup manifest bytes. The vulnerability does not return the improperly-read bytes back to the attacker's server, so a successful attack would need separate implementation-specific secrets for that. Integrity impact is unlikely; in particular, the applicable formatter does not support %n. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-18447 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL SQL-language functions allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via an output parameter of type "any". Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-6460 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.8 | Type confusion in PostgreSQL allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE primarily. Other DDL attack routes exist, such as "ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN; ROLLBACK; ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN". The system had inadequate tracking of typed values, and values were not self-identifying. Stale values could appear in data dictionary entries, PL/pgSQL variables, and many other parts of the system. PostgreSQL Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-6467 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2
item.description: Thursday 12 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.2 | Uncontrolled search path element in PostgreSQL CREATE EXTENSION allows an attacker with database-level CREATE privilege to execute arbitrary code as the bootstrap superuser, via ALTER SCHEMA ... RENAME or CREATE EXTENSION ... SCHEMA "$user". ALTER EXTENSION was also affected. A trusted-extension script located the wrong object and executed arbitrary SQL of the attacker's choice. Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
